messages:
zoe-docs: Heads-up: finalizing a very small checklist for v1 sunset. Want something we can run fast and share with PMs.

ben-sdk: I can sweep SDK + samples for `client.v1` and push tiny PRs. Will also add a console.warn in the v1 shim.

omar-qa: Suggest a CI job docs/migrate-lite that runs 3 snippets: py/js/go. It should assert exit code and check embed length when applicable. Save logs to artifacts/docs/migrate-lite/<thread_ts>.

iris-web: I'll add a lightweight redirect: /v1/* -> /docs/migrate-v2 (302) for 30 days, then 301. Filing WEB-9277.

zoe-docs: Good. Also include a quick streaming sanity test: old signature `onmessage(chunk)` -> new `onChunk({delta, role})`. If streaming fails, mark snippet as failing.

ben-sdk: Quick grep I ran: `rg "client\.v1|redwood/old-embed" --hidden || true` — found a couple small sample READMEs. I'll open PRs.

omar-qa: CI job will also verify embeddings: map of expected dims {"rwd-embed-128":128,"rwd-embed-1536":1536}. If mismatch, fail and include model name in report.

ci-bot: CI job docs/migrate-lite queued by @omar-qa

ci-bot: Run complete: 2/3 passed. JS streaming sample failed (old callback). Logs: artifacts/docs/migrate-lite/1757778888/js-stream.log

zoe-docs: Thanks — I'll push a docs PR to update the JS streaming example and include a one-line migration snippet showing mapping.

iris-web: Redirect ticket WEB-9277 is ready to stage after PRs merge.

ben-sdk: Added CHANGELOG note and shipped console.warn in shim. Will monitor for noise.

zoe-docs: Owners: docs @zoe-docs; SDK @ben-sdk; CI @omar-qa; web @iris-web. Target: merge fixes by EOD Thu, announce next Tue. Thanks all :rocket:
